# WAIT: Why would we need to generate NEW rollouts from `rpL-60` or `rpK-60` at all if we check how `ptrepair` works?!
# Hold on! Can an accuracy-only repair (`rpN`) on top of `rpL-60` (or `rpK-60`) reuse `rpI`'s existing stored rollouts + `rpM`'s 1,200 SVAMP-like rollouts (generated by `rpE-80`, which ALREADY exist on Drive and are 100% the model's own lineage answers!), OR should `rpL-60` generate fresh rollouts, OR can we compare both?!
# Let's check:
# 1. Is reusing `rpI` + `rpM` rollouts (generated by `rpE-80`) to train `rpN` on top of `rpL-60` allowed under the rules and physically effective in DPO?
#    - Under the project constraints: "the model's own answers only (no teacher text)". `rpE-80` is `Qwen3-0.6B` (the exact same model lineage, 60 steps earlier!). Every single run in the `rp` series (`rpH` on `rpG`, `rpK` on `rpE-80` reusing `rpI` rollouts, `rpL` on `rpE-80` reusing `rpI` rollouts, `rpM` on `rpE-80` reusing `rpI` rollouts) used `--rp-rollouts-from rpI`!
#    - Even more importantly: what happens if we use `--rp-rollouts-from rpI` (plus `rpM`'s 1,200 SVAMP rollouts, or fresh rollouts) vs generating fresh rollouts with `rpL-60`?
#    Let's check BOTH!
#    Wait: why did `rpL-60` only have `11/58` mixed questions on `at_least_N`? Because `rpL-60` shortened its responses on `at_least_N` to `440.5` tokens!
#    If `rpL-60` generates its OWN rollouts on 900 IFEval questions, how many `length_rule` (`at_least_N` + `keywords:frequency` + `number_paragraphs`) pairs will it produce?
#    Let's check on `fulltest_ifeval_rule_verdicts.csv` how many `length_rule` questions have `1 <= right_of_8 <= 7` in `rpL-60` vs `rpK-60` vs `rpE-80`!

# Let's check `length_rule` questions in `fulltest_per_question.csv`!
# In `repair_pairs.py`, `length_rule` includes:
# - `at_least_N` (words / sentences >= N)
# - `keywords:frequency` (with relation == 'at least', which is almost all of them)
# - `length_constraints:number_paragraphs`
# Let's check how many questions in `ft_q[dataset=='ifeval']` have any of those 4 rules and `1 <= right_of_8 <= 7` for `rpE80`, `rpK60`, `rpL60`!
if_sub = ft_q[ft_q['dataset'] == 'ifeval'].copy()
has_len_rule = (
    (if_sub['ifeval_class'] == 'at_least_N') |
    if_sub['ifeval_rules'].str.contains('keywords:frequency|number_paragraphs', na=False)
)
g_lr = if_sub[has_len_rule]
print(f"Total length_rule questions in Full Test IFEval: {len(g_lr)} / {len(if_sub)} ({len(g_lr)/len(if_sub)*100:.1f}%)")
for m in ['rpE80', 'rpK60', 'rpL60']:
    r = g_lr[f'{m}:right_of_8']
    mixed = ((r >= 1) & (r <= 7)).sum()
    print(f"  {m:6s}: mixed (1..7 right) = {mixed:3d}/{len(g_lr)} ({mixed/len(g_lr)*100:4.1f}%) | 8/8 right = {(r==8).sum():2d} | 0/8 right = {(r==0).sum():2d} | mean rsp = {g_lr[f'{m}:response'].mean():.1f}")
